response.sql: WITH pair AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pair), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - st.overall_mean AS above_mean FROM pair p CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE p.pair_avg > st.overall_mean), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst, AVG(above_mean) AS avg_above FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst, avg_above, avg_analyst / (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst) FROM per_type) AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_type

assumptions.assumption: Each sentiment row is joined to its transaction by transref = transreg and to the trader by transactionrecord.trdref = trader.tradereg using inner joins, so unmatched sentiment rows are dropped as requested. The trader type is trader.tradekind.
AVG ignores NULL anlycount values, so a pair's average is over its non-null counts. A pair whose counts are all NULL has a NULL average and is excluded from the overall mean and from the kept set.

The overall mean is the mean of all pair averages before any filtering. 'Above' means strictly greater than that mean. The 'amount above' is pair_avg minus that overall mean, averaged over kept pairs.

'The mean of this figure across all trader types' is the mean of the per-type kept-pair average analyst counts over the trader types that have at least one kept pair (the types that appear in the output). A NULL trader type, if present, forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The denominator averages over every trader type present in the matched data, counting a type with no kept pairs as 0 rather than leaving it out.
alternatives.sql: WITH pair AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = t.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), stats AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_mean FROM pair), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - st.overall_mean AS above_mean FROM pair p CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE p.pair_avg > st.overall_mean), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst, AVG(above_mean) AS avg_above FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind), all_types AS (SELECT DISTINCT tradekind FROM pair), denom AS (SELECT AVG(COALESCE(pt.avg_analyst, 0)) AS m FROM all_types a LEFT JOIN per_type pt ON pt.tradekind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tradekind) SELECT pt.tradekind, pt.avg_analyst, pt.avg_above, pt.avg_analyst / d.m AS ratio_to_mean FROM per_type pt CROSS JOIN denom d
